title: Mapping effective connectivity of human amygdala with intracranial stimulation - es-TT evoked potentials (Sawada-2022-mapping-10.1038/s41467-022-32644-y)
description: Intracranial EEG evoked-potential epochs recorded during single-pulse electrical stimulation of the human amygdala (electrical stimulation tract-tracing, es-TT) in neurosurgical patients. The dataset includes 46 stimulation runs from 11 participants, sampled at 8 kHz, and supports mapping the effective connectivity of amygdala subdivisions. It was converted to BIDS from the OSF release accompanying Sawada et al., Nature Communications 2022.
methods_description: Single-pulse electrical stimulation of the amygdala was delivered while evoked potentials were recorded with intracranial depth, strip and grid electrodes at 8 kHz. Epochs of about 2 s (16001 samples, typically 60 per run) are time-locked to the stimulus artefact. Channels with NaN samples are marked bad.
